pull_request.title: fix(config): reject non-mapping secrets and workflows with a config error
pull_request.body:
`Config.load` crashed with an `AttributeError` traceback when `secrets:` or `workflows:` in `.config/tend.yaml` held a list or a scalar (for example `secrets: [allowed]` or `workflows: [review]`), where the neighbouring `codex:` and `checks:` keys already fail with a config error naming the key. Both now raise `secrets must be a mapping` / `workflows must be a mapping`, which `tend init` and `tend check` print as an ordinary error. A parametrized regression test in `test_config_edge_cases.py` covers both keys and failed before the fix.

Two dead bits in the same file go with it: `MergePolicy.bot_can_merge`, which nothing outside its own two test assertions reads, and a "POSIX-ish env var name" comment whose regex was removed earlier. No behaviour change from either.

Found by the nightly survey of `generator/src/tend/config.py`. The local generator suite passes apart from the two `test_refresh_consumers.py` tests that need DNS.
